concurrency.description: Default number of parallel API calls

mergeWidth.description: Default number of items to merge at once in hierarchical tasks

transcribe.description: Transcribes comments with attachments into clean markdown; typed-only comments are stored as-is without an LLM call

triage.description: Labels short ungrouped typed comments as no_substance / stance_only / substantive so only substantive ones get condensed

condense.description: Extracts structured sections; Flash-Lite for typed comments, 3.8 Flash with thinking off for attachment letters (Flash-Lite omitted recommendations in long letters; thinking added cost with no quality gain in 2026-10 trials)

discoverThemes.description: Input: every form-letter representative, promoted member and attachment letter, plus a seeded sample of typedSample typed-only comments (0 = none); no_substance/stance_only triaged comments excluded. Batches are sized by the condensed text actually sent

batching.description: Large batches for initial theme discovery

extractThemeContent.description: Short units: Flash-Lite gate picks theme groups, then batched extraction per group. Long units: one call each with the whole taxonomy

summarizeThemes.description: Phases across all themes: per-batch summaries, then mergeWidth-way merges level by level for large themes, then JSON structuring. All calls go through runLlmRequests (--batch, llm_cache)

batching.description: Batching for v2 summarization based on extracted content

discoverEntities.description: One LLM call builds an entity taxonomy (with match terms) from a seeded ~150k-word sample of units; every unit is then scanned locally. Entities are kept if found in at least min(1% of units, minUnitsCap) units and at most 50%

tagCampaigns.description: Embeds units (gemini-embedding-2), groups them by average-linkage cosine at levels[0], and has an LLM judge each group as a campaign (common template/brief) or same-topic letters; rejected groups are split at the next level and re-judged. Then merges duplicate campaigns (centroids >= mergeLevel, LLM-confirmed) and adds near-miss comments (>= expandMinNeighbors members at >= expandLevel, LLM-confirmed). Judge: 3.5 Flash-Lite accepted 71% of candidate groups including plainly independent dermatology letters; 3.8 Flash without thinking was stricter and matched hand review

scopeRelevance.description: Scoped analyses: judges whether each analysis unit addresses the scope and copies the in-scope passages. Short typed units (typed text, or the condensed summary when shorter) are judged 40 per call; attachment letters, promoted members and long typed comments from their full transcript, packed up to longBatchWords/longBatchSize per call. Both use 3.8 Flash without thinking: on the PFS sample Flash-Lite marked 29 of 657 short units relevant for an interoperability scope, nearly all generic fee-cut letters (3.8 Flash: 0, and no in-scope short units were missed); for long letters, low thinking (14/20 known positives) and one letter per call (15/20) both found fewer than no-thinking packed calls (18/20). 'label' drafts a scope's name/summary, 'draft' drafts a scope prompt from a seed comment
